content: Today, we're announcing a first-of-its-kind partnership that brings enterprise-grade AI to the United States Government.Enterprise Pro for Government offers agencies powerful, model-agnostic AI with secure-by-default guarantees for all federal users.Through our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA), Perplexity is now the first major AI company to enter a direct government-wide contract.Read more about Enterprise Pro for Government:https://lnkd.in/exEGP68k

A trustworthy AI Assistant must be personal, transparent, and have sound judgement.Comet now shows you exactly what it’s doing, lets you determine how it acts, and asks permission before completing sensitive actions.Read our latest blog post:https://lnkd.in/eb_fgbzRNow, it's easier to see when the Comet Assistant is browsing for you and what actions it’s taking on your behalf.You can always stop the Assistant or provide more guidance.Comet will now ask if you want your Assistant to handle the task itself.You can choose to browse yourself, give Comet permission to browse on your behalf once, or let the Assistant automatically browse for you when it detects the chance to be useful.When Comet Assistant recognizes that a task is important, such as logging in to a certain site or completing a purchase from your shopping cart, it will pause and ask for permission before proceeding.Your AI assistant is truly yours.Comet keeps you firmly in control, prioritizing visibility, adapting to your preferences, and requesting permission before sensitive actions.

Today we’re launching Perplexity Patents, the world’s first AI patent research agent that makes IP intelligence accessible to everyone.Read more about Perplexity Patents in our latest blog:https://lnkd.in/grRR__XVPerplexity Patents extends our citation-first approach to patent search, allowing users to search for patents without complicated keyword searches.Ask Perplexity, "Are there any patents on AI for language learning?"We are launching Perplexity Patents as a beta product, available worldwide starting today.While in beta, Perplexity Patents will be free for all users. Today we're rolling out major upgrades that significantly improve the performance and overall outcomes of the Comet Assistant.Comet can now handle more complex, multi-site workflows while working across multiple tabs in parallel.Our internal testing shows a 23% improvement in performance, so you can expect more accurate answers and more successful completions, even on long or multi-step jobs.We’ve also changed how Comet Assistant asks for your permission.Comet Assistant will now ask for your approval before doing anything in your browser. Once you approve, it’ll remember your preference throughout.Read more about the latest improvements to the Comet Assistant in our blog:https://lnkd.in/gtYvAx5M

Weight transfer is one of the biggest bottlenecks when performing distributed RL on high-capacity models.Our first Perplexity Research blog explains how Perplexity's inference engineers harnessed RDMA point-to-point communication to unlock ultra-fast parameter updates for trillion-parameter models.https://lnkd.in/gw_6vxYVBy harnessing low-level RDMA primitives, static scheduling, and pipelining, we accelerate updates by an order of magnitude, to just 1.3 seconds per update.
